inspiration.observed_pattern: A full-outer relationship is assembled from two outer-join branches with UNION ALL, then grouped JSON_ARRAYAGG projections preserve values from both sides while COUNT(DISTINCT ...) measures the combined signal set.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a league badge-and-award report. A left-join branch plus an unmatched-award branch emulates a full outer relationship, grouped JSON arrays retain NULL placeholders and duplicate badges, and distinct counts summarize each player's observed signals. The schema, identifiers, rows, and game domain are newly authored.

fixture_notes: Player 1 has two awards and one badge, player 2 has only a badge, and an award for player 4 has no matching player row. The union preserves player-side and award-side unmatched rows; JSON_ARRAYAGG exposes NULL placeholders while COUNT(DISTINCT) ignores them.
determinism_notes: Player IDs, award IDs, labels, aggregate ordering, and final player ordering are fixed. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE league_players (player_id INT PRIMARY KEY, player_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, best_badge VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE player_awards (award_id INT PRIMARY KEY, player_id INT NOT NULL, award_code VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH badge_award_usage AS (SELECT p.player_id, p.best_badge, a.award_code FROM league_players AS p LEFT JOIN player_awards AS a ON a.player_id = p.player_id UNION ALL SELECT a.player_id, p.best_badge, a.award_code FROM player_awards AS a LEFT JOIN league_players AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id WHERE p.player_id IS NULL) SELECT player_id, JSON_ARRAYAGG(best_badge ORDER BY best_badge ASC) AS badges, JSON_ARRAYAGG(award_code ORDER BY award_code ASC) AS awards, COUNT(DISTINCT best_badge) + COUNT(DISTINCT award_code) AS signal_count FROM badge_award_usage GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY player_id
